related.title: 微核心作業系統架構
related.why: 保護域與硬體資源治理共用
related.whyEn: Protection domains and hardware governance transfer
related.transfer: 保護域與硬體資源治理共用
related.transferEn: Protection domains and hardware governance transfer
related.difference: 微核心服務隔離不同於完整客體 OS 虛擬化
related.differenceEn: Service isolation differs from full guest OS virtualization
practice: 由「主客體邊界」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「微核心服務隔離不同於完整客體 OS 虛擬化」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From host/guest boundaries, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Service isolation differs from full guest OS virtualization", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 主客體與 vCPU
history.text: 官方公開資料「KVM API」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「主客體邊界」及「vCPU」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference KVM API supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with host/guest boundaries and vcpus before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
